# Fixed list for scripts/search_quality.mjs (see README.md, "Search quality"). Needs a build that has the AWS SSO
# task page (guide/user/integrations/aws-sso, on agent-fleet main since #3566; not in v0.41.0).
複数のプロファイルを使う
ログインが切れたとき
SSM で EC2 にログイン
ワークスペースを作り直す
# 共有サインイン / shared sign-in allow 5: the word is only in the body of the aws-sso page (the section is headed
# 「1 回のログインで複数のプロファイルを使う」), while ref/aws-profiles has it as a heading and pages about sign-in
# (operate/secure/dev-signin, user/settings/display) match サインイン many times. The browser splits the query into
# 共有 / サイン / イン, and no ranking setting changes that order (#3574). With the word in that section's heading the
# query ranks 2 (measured on a re-indexed copy). k-k1/agent-fleet#4013 adds that heading; the site builds from a
# release, so keep 5 until a release containing #4013 is pinned in scripts/docs-ref.txt, then tighten 共有サインイン to 3.
# shared sign-in allows 8: the operate task pages (secure/dev-signin, signin/*) carry "sign-in" in their titles
# and rank above the expected page for the bare words; the specific query 「共有ログイン」 still holds at 3.
# The bare word "deploy" matches nearly every operate page, so it is not a query: "choose where to deploy" and
# 「デプロイ先」 ask for the choosing page, and "deploy on ECS" for the ECS install page (the runbook index is
# only a table of contents now).
# AWS プロファイル allows 5: af-aws-exec, aws-sso and the new aws-emulator page all say 「AWS プロファイル」 often and rank above the reference page.
# ログインが切れたとき allows 5: the agents' troubleshooting page and the Codex / Claude pages answer "the login expired" for agent sign-in, and rank above the AWS SSO page once the old chapters are gone.
# Added for #3574 (task pages, compound words, English counterparts). Each wants 3; ワークツリー, 作業ディスク and
# エージェントメモリ are at 3 on purpose, not loosened: the worktrees page says 「ワークツリー」 only in its title (the
# body says 作業コピー), the query splits into ワーク / ツリー and ワーク prefix-matches ワークスペース; 作業ディスク is also
# a heading of operate/aws-ecs/workspace-size; every memory page says エージェントメモリ. 作業グループ is the page
# title now (page-titles.tsv still says ワーキングセット, which the guide no longer uses).
